headline: Browsers block eMudhra certificates after weak key compromise
summary: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak they could be recovered and used to forge trusted certificates, prompting Mozilla, Google and Apple to block them.

claims.statement: Certificate authority eMudhra's private keys were compromised, letting anyone forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites.

sources.quote: Massive clean-up job under way because this mess makes it possible to impersonate any website or service

Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites.

claims.statement: eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates.

sources.quote: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites.

claims.statement: One of the compromised private keys was reportedly just the number '4'.

sources.quote: Indian certification authority eMudhra’s private keys compromised – one of them was the number ‘4’

claims.statement: Mozilla, Google and Apple are blocking the compromised eMudhra certificates.
